name: repo-add
description: Add packages to a repository database

name: -n
--new
options.description: Only add packages that are not already in the database

name: -p
--prevent-downgrade
options.description: Do not add package to database if a newer version is already present

options.name: --include-sigs
options.description: Include package PGP signatures in the repository database (if available)

name: -s
--sign
options.description: Sign database with GnuPG after update

name: -k
--key
options.description: Use the specified key to sign the database

name: -R
--remove
options.description: Remove old package file from disk after updating database

name: -w
--wait-for-lock
options.description: Retry to acquire lock file until success
